stem: A microscopic mite is confirmed on newly introduced plant material in one room. Which response best protects clean areas while scope is being determined?
choices: Move suspect plants through clean rooms to compare symptoms.
Maintain authorized isolation and sanitation, restrict unnecessary movement of suspect material/tools/people, and intensify defined scouting around plausible pathways.
Remove all records so the source cannot be blamed.
Assume every room is equally infested without inspecting them.
rationale: Plant material, tools, people and other pathways can contribute to spread; authorized containment and focused scouting protect clean areas without overstating the affected scope.
